caption: The drawing features a single object, a goblet or chalice placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The goblet is depicted in shades of brown and golden yellow, rendering the appearance of transparent or translucent glass with highlights and shadows to suggest its three-dimensionality. The base is circular and sturdy, supporting a short stem that leads up to a rounded, bowl-shaped cup with a wide, flared rim. The goblet is shown without any contents, and there are no additional objects or decorations in the image. The drawing is rendered with careful attention to the glass’s reflective and refractive qualities, and the goblet casts a faint shadow on the surface beneath it. There is a faint handwritten signature or text in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Salt Cellar
